card.name: Dismissive labels like marketing gimmick
card.fires_on: The word right after 'a', 'just' or 'another' where the writer is calling something a trick or ploy, most often 'marketing' before gimmick, tool or strategy. Also the start of words like 'ploy' or 'contraption'.

modes.label: Marketing as a trick
modes.description: The word 'marketing' used to dismiss something as a sales gimmick or tool.
modes.example: Is augmented reality the next big thing or a<< marketing>> gimmick?

modes.label: Start of a ploy or gadget word
modes.description: The first piece of a word like ploy or contraption after 'another' or 'similar'.
modes.example: this is just another manipulative<< p>>loy to coercively acquire control over land

modes.label: Filler before a put-down noun
modes.description: Small words such as 'a' or 'another' just before a disparaging noun.
modes.example: most people and even some scientists think that it is just<< a>> waste of time.

card.writes: It favors short word starts such as ' r', ' p' and ' cover', with no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up when the writer is about to call something a gimmick, ploy or waste of time.
